description:
*Book a call now to become a cloned First Mover:*  – https://firstmovers.ai/ai-clone-studio/

*I almost didn't film this. My AI clone has made about 700 videos on this channel, I've made maybe 6 with my real face, and there's one story only I can tell you.*

Two years ago I was in bed for a year with long covid. Couldn't work. Couldn’t film. Couldn’t function. 

And the business made more money that next year running off a *clone* than it did when I had 100 people and was working 100 hour weeks.

This is the real me, no polish, telling you what actually happened. The receipts from 15 months of Dr. McCoy on YouTube, going from 20K views a month to 2M. The confession about being the anti-AI writer who got it wrong. Why a face and a voice is just the puppet, and what *Voice DNA* puts underneath it. And the part of all this that honestly scares me.

I got *liberation through the machines* by accident. You get to choose it.
